id.description: Id of the company location, the `tenantLocationId` of location-occupancy. Each record is one office or site of a company.

address.description: Street address of the company location. For most locations this is the address of the building it occupies.

aliases.description: Other names the company location is known by, such as a former or legal name.

businessStatus.description: Whether the company location is still in business. Out-of-business locations are included; their past tenancies are in location-occupancy.

locationPhone.description: Main phone number of the company location. The number is fake: area code 555, the same fake for the same real number in every dataset.

numEmployees.description: Number of employees at this location, as researched by CoStar.

profile.description: The company profile shown for this location: its type, industry, website and description.

mailingAddress.description: Postal address of the company location, when it differs from or adds to `address`, such as a PO box.

name.description: Name of the company location, such as `The Hileman Company LLC`.

officeType.description: What this location is to its company, such as main headquarters, branch or single location.

suite.description: Suite or unit at the address, as entered. Values can carry trailing spaces.

brandProfiles.description: Brands the location operates under, on the few locations that have one.

latitude.description: A map position for the location itself, on 164 records. It is usually within about 100 meters of `address.latitude` and `address.longitude`; prefer those.

longitude.description: Longitude of the location's own map position, on 164 records. Prefer `address.longitude`.

id.description: Id of the address. On most occupancies it equals the occupancy's `addressId`, and it matches an address id in commercial-property.

buildingName.description: Name of the building, such as `Century Plaza Towers North`.

buildingNumber.description: Building number or name within a complex, such as `2` or `Phoenix`.

city.description: City name as entered, so capitalization varies (`Houston`, `houston`).

crossStreetDescription.description: Nearest cross street or a short location note, such as `SWC FM 1960 W. & Falling Creek Dr.`. Usually empty.

postcode.description: Postal code. In the US this is the ZIP code.

zip.description: ZIP code, filled on older addresses. Prefer `postcode`.

postalBox.description: PO box number, on the few addresses that have one.

state.description: Two-letter state code, such as `TX` or `CA`.

streetDirection.description: Direction before the street name, such as `N` or `W`.

streetName.description: Street name without number, direction or type, such as `Wilshire`.

streetNumberEndRange.description: Last street number when the address covers a range, such as `1120` for 1100–1120.

streetSuffix.description: Direction after the street name, such as `E`.

businessType.description: What kind of business the company is, from a real estate point of view, such as Brokerage, Lender or Retailer. `0` (Unknown) for most companies that are only tenants.

businessSubtype.description: A finer split of `businessType`, such as Brokerage_TenantRep. The name starts with its business type.

industryType.description: Industry of the company. Use this, not the occupancy's `industryType`, once a tenant is known.

websiteUrl.description: Company website. A few links to business directories carry a fake phone number in the address, so they do not work.

locationBio.description: Description of the company, in English. Email addresses and phone numbers in it are fake.

companyName.description: Name of the company the location belongs to, such as `Prudential` for the location named `Prudential Financial`. Several locations share it.

companyNameLocal.description: The company name in a local spelling, on the few records that have one.

locationName.description: Name of the location under that brand.

locationPhone.description: Phone number of the location under that brand. The number is fake, as in `locationPhone`.
